issue.title: [Epic] Local-first dev experience (unblock from missing live API)
issue.body:
### Summary

**Priority epic** — unblock mobile development without requiring every engineer to run Docker locally. On the Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only) baseline, developers point `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` at a **real Fluent API** and sync into on-device SQLite. This epic documents the workflow and closes the local Docker My Work gap on the server side.

**Pivot (2026-06):** Mobile mock seed (#106) and offline auth bypass (#107) are **descoped**. Data arrives via `syncAllData()` from real APIs — not fake mobile fixtures.

**Verify pass (2026-07):** #108 docs complete and closed. #106/#107 descoped. Epic complete; fluent-api seeder (E2) remains optional follow-up outside this epic.

### Sub-issues / deliverables

- [x] **#108** — Local development workflow docs (hosted dev + local Docker)
- [ ] **fluent-api** — Local dev data seeder (project + chapter assignment for translator; Docker Postgres only) — optional E2 follow-up
- [x] ~~#106~~ — Descoped (mobile mock seed superseded)
- [x] ~~#107~~ — Descoped (offline mock mode superseded; optional app-shell hardening tracked separately)

### Two co-equal dev paths

| Path | `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` |
|------|---------------------------|
| Hosted dev | `https://dev.api.fluent.bible` |
| Local Docker | `http://10.0.2.2:9999` (`./fapi.sh up` + `db:init` in fluent-api) |

Web app: https://dev.app.fluent.bible

### Dependency ordering

1. **#108 (E1)** — Document both paths (unblocks team immediately for hosted dev) — **done**
2. **fluent-api seeder (E2)** — Populate My Work on local Docker stack (optional)
3. **Optional** — App-shell error when API unreachable (reduced #107)

Unblocks feature epics (#115/#116/#117/#118) for UI development against real data.

### Open dependencies

- [x] Postgres read access to shared dev (inspection only)
- [ ] Hosted-dev login credentials (team to share)

### Links

- fluent-api local stack: [PR #187](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/187), [`fapi.sh`](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/blob/main/fapi.sh)
- Related: #112 (onboarding consolidation)

comments.body:
## Epic pivot — local development workflow (not mobile mock seed)

After reviewing `fluent-api` on `main` ([PR #187](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/187) local dev seeders + [`fapi.sh`](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/blob/main/fapi.sh)) and confirming hosted dev is live, this epic pivots:

**We are NOT building** mobile SQLite mock seed (#106) or offline auto-auth bypass (#107). The mobile app gets data via **sync hydration** from real APIs.

### Two co-equal dev paths (switch via `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` only)

| Path | API URL | Use when |
|------|---------|----------|
| **Hosted dev** | `https://dev.api.fluent.bible` (same backend as Azure `scribe-server-dev`) | See shared remote data; no Docker |
| **Local Docker** | `http://10.0.2.2:9999` after `./fapi.sh up` + `db:init` | Seed your own Postgres; offline API work |

Web app for login/testing: https://dev.app.fluent.bible

### Revised deliverables

1. **#108** — Document local development workflow (both paths) — primary
2. **NEW fluent-api issue** — Local dev data seeder (project + chapter assignment for translator My Work on Docker only)
3. **#106 / #107** — Descoped (superseded by real APIs)
4. **Optional** — App-shell error when API URL unset/unreachable (reduced #107 scope)

### Dependencies

- Postgres read access to shared dev: **done** (inspection/debugging only)
- Hosted-dev login credentials: **open** (need team account; `t@fluent.local` is local Docker only)

Hosted dev already has rich data (100+ users, 297 projects, 27k+ assignments). My Work works once you have login creds.

## Epic delivery — PRs open

Phase 0 ticket hygiene is complete (#106/#107 closed, #108 updated, fluent-api#207 created).

### Pull requests (awaiting merge)

| Issue | Repo | PR |
|-------|------|-----|
| #108 — local development workflow docs | fluent-mobile | https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/136 |
| fluent-api#207 — local dev project seeder | fluent-api | https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/208 |
| #137 — app shell API config/connectivity (optional, reduced #107) | fluent-mobile | https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/138 |

### Verification status

- **Automated gates:** passed locally on all three branches (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, tests).
- **Manual — hosted dev path:** docs in PR #136 describe `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://dev.api.fluent.bible`; requires team login credentials (still an open dependency on this epic).
- **Manual — local Docker path:** after PR #208 merges, `./fapi.sh up` + seeds → sign in as `t@fluent.local` / `t@123456` → mobile sync should show GEN 1 in My Work.

Epic stays **open** until #108 + #207 are merged and manual smoke is confirmed. Close with `Fixes #119` from a merge commit or follow-up comment once verified.

## Epic closeout

**Delivered:** fluent-mobile PR #136 — local development workflow docs (hosted dev + local Docker, sync hydration, no mobile mock seed).

**Descoped / closed:**
- fluent-api#207 + PR #208 — automated project seeder not needed
- fluent-mobile#138 — optional app-shell hardening, closed without merge

**Acceptance:** Devs pick API via `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`, sign in, sync. Local Docker My Work: web UI project setup or use hosted dev.

Closing epic — docs are the durable deliverable.
Reopened: epic deliverable #108 still has open PR #136 awaiting merge. Per prior epic comment, this epic should stay open until #108 is merged and verified.
